scientific_integrity: Exact recurrence, symbolic all-parameter small-graph coefficient certificates and independent rational witness verification. Originality limited by inspected accessible sources; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected homogeneous Markovian SIR, single seeded infection; all positive transmission rates covered for the four-vertex bound; a five-vertex witness at beta=2. No claims for peak incidence, multi-seed, SIS, heterogeneous contacts, or empirical burden.
title: Five vertices are sharp for disagreement between epidemic final size and peak infectious burden
